title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: Decision of the AI Office presents the official stance and guidelines the office adopts regarding the development, deployment, and oversight of AI technologies. It establishes key principles for safety, ethics, transparency, and accountability that all stakeholders must follow.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This policy explains how an AI office can fill vacancies for technology specialists in AI. It outlines the qualifications, job responsibilities, and guidelines for selecting and managing these specialists.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The policy outlines the opening for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office, detailing the role’s responsibilities and the qualifications required. It also explains how the position will guide AI strategy, promote scientific integrity, and support decision‑making across the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: The document outlines how AI can help manage office vacancies for legal officers, including using automated tools for job matching, recruitment, and compliance with employment regulations. It also provides guidelines to ensure the hiring process remains fair, transparent, and protects candidate privacy.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy explains how to fill vacant policy officer positions within the AI office, outlining the qualifications and responsibilities required for the role. It also provides guidance on the hiring process, selection criteria, and application procedures for interested candidates.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts tasked with reviewing the European Union's proposed AI regulations and providing evidence‑based recommendations to balance innovation with safety. They examine potential risks, ethical concerns, and the societal impact of AI to help shape clear, enforceable rules.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The Draft Standardisation Request proposes establishing uniform guidelines for developing and deploying AI systems, aiming to create consistency across the industry. It seeks to promote safety, accountability, and best practices by outlining standardized procedures and compliance requirements.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation on a Community of Practice (CoP) policy. Stakeholders are invited to provide feedback and help shape the guidelines.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: The policy invites people and groups to express interest in forming or joining a Community of Practice focused on AI. It provides basic information and next steps for those who want to contribute and collaborate in this initiative.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This document provides a clear overview of the iterative drafting process, showing how each draft is reviewed, refined, and improved through multiple rounds. The accompanying graphic illustrates the key steps and feedback loops that guide the drafting cycle, helping teams to collaborate effectively and produce high‑quality documents.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document presents a visual timeline of the drafting process for the CoP, showing each phase in chronological order. It highlights key milestones and the overall flow from initial planning through to final approval.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document outlines the initial guidelines and standards for responsible AI development and deployment. It serves as a framework to ensure ethical, transparent, and accountable practices in AI usage.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: The document is the second draft of a Code of Practice, outlining updated rules and best‑practice guidelines for safely and ethically developing and using AI systems. It covers key areas like transparency, fairness, security, and accountability, giving organizations clear standards to follow.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document outlines the third draft of a code of practice for AI, setting guidelines and standards for responsible development and deployment. It includes principles, best practices, and compliance requirements to ensure safety, fairness, and accountability.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft proposes a collaborative framework for the responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence technologies. It outlines principles such as transparency, accountability, and inclusive benefit sharing to guide global AI practices.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is an international agreement that establishes shared standards for responsible AI development, emphasizing safety, fairness, and transparency. It commits governments, companies, and researchers to collaborate, share best practices, and enforce regulations to prevent harmful AI impacts.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The guidelines outline specific AI practices that are prohibited, such as deploying AI for targeted manipulation, disinformation, or any activity that could cause significant harm to individuals or society. They explain the rationale for each restriction and provide examples to help organizations understand and comply with the rules for safe and responsible AI use.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This document explains how to identify and classify AI systems, detailing the characteristics and components that determine an AI system. It provides clear criteria and examples to help organizations recognize AI technology in their products and services.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: The policy focuses on improving communication strategies to support and accelerate the growth of start‑ups and innovative businesses. It aims to create a more collaborative environment that encourages investment, knowledge sharing, and rapid development of new ideas.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups aims to support early‑stage high‑performance computing businesses across Europe, providing them access to cutting‑edge HPC resources and expertise. It offers funding, training, and networking opportunities to help these startups grow and innovate within the HPC ecosystem.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar presents a slideshow on risk management, covering key concepts and strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks in various contexts. Participants will learn best practices for protecting assets and ensuring organizational resilience.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This document presents a webinar that explains key risk‑management strategies. It covers how to identify, assess, and reduce risks when working with AI systems.
